title: The click-away timer encodes a mode ("a blur is pending") beside the saved-value editor's state
evidence: widget-src/src/components/MatrixSavedCells.tsx ValueCell (moved from BloodTestTimeline.tsx in PR 1456): blurTimerRef and afterRelease (refs) arm the click-away save in onBlur beside typed and saving (useState); every exit must remember clearBlurTimer(), and submit() forgot it until the fix that added this lead (an Enter that failed after a click away and back asked the correction twice). The editor wants one union, e.g. editing | blurPending | saving, with a pure transition, the next time someone works in that file. The next change to BloodTestTimeline.tsx (1020 lines against a 500 target) splits the cell editor out first; this union belongs there. Joining statements on one line to stay under the ratchet (PR 1298) was a one-off, not a pattern.
